backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping features to related source files and components for build tracking.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file providing short descriptions of key frontend components and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining theme variables and light/dark color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling proposal UI, evasive No button, teasing popups, success fireworks, and layout refs.
frontend/src/components/Fireworks.tsx: Generates looping animated particle fireworks using timed particle bursts.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Creates drifting floating-heart particles with a soft patterned overlay.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hook managing login state, stored identities, and AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file exporting no backend query logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, OKLCH color tokens, Valentine-themed light/dark palettes, base styles, and custom utilities plus animations for hearts and premium background effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping App with React Query and Internet Identity providers and importing global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with plugins, OKLCH-based color tokens, Valentine palette extensions, custom radii, shadows, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Captures the project’s feature state and requirements for the Valentine proposal app, detailing existing UI behaviors and planned enhancements like refined No interactions and improved visuals.
